# The `emit_layout` contract

**Contract version:** `0.1.0`
**Enforced by:** `includes/class-validator.php` and `assets/validate.js` (identical rules, codes, paths and messages)
**Source of truth:** `catalog/catalog.json`, generated by `scripts/generate-catalog.php`
**Prompt + tool schema:** `includes/class-prompt.php`, generated from the same catalog

> **The one rule:** the LLM never emits Styble block markup. It emits a JSON tree of
> sparse attributes against this contract. An applier turns that tree into real Styble
> blocks. The applier owns correctness — the model only fills a schema.

The validator never coerces. A tree either passes or is rejected with an explicit
reason; there is no silent repair and no partial application.

---

## Envelope

```json
{
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "root": { "block": "styble/container", "attrs": {}, "children": [] }
}
```

| Key | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | yes | Must equal the catalog's `contractVersion` exactly. |
| `root` | yes | A single node. One tree = one section (or one page's outer container). |

No other top-level keys. Model chatter, explanations, and confidence scores are
rejected (`envelope_unknown_key`) rather than ignored — if the model is putting prose
in the envelope, the prompt needs fixing.

## Node

```json
{ "block": "styble/advanced-text", "attrs": { "textHTMLTag": "h1" }, "children": [] }
```

| Key | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `block` | yes | Full block name, `styble/<slug>`. Must be in the v1 allowlist. |
| `attrs` | no | Sparse object. Omitted keys fall back to `block.json` defaults. |
| `children` | no | Array of nodes. Only legal on blocks that render InnerBlocks. |

No other node keys. Attributes are **sparse by design**: emit only what you mean to
change. Everything else is filled by the block's own defaults at apply time, which is
what keeps the fragile surface small.

## Allowlisted blocks (v1)

`styble/container`, `styble/column`, `styble/advanced-text`, `styble/advanced-buttons`,
`styble/advanced-button`, `styble/advanced-image`, `styble/info-box`,
`styble/icon-picker`, `styble/icon-list`, `styble/icon-list-item`, `styble/separator`

Other Styble blocks exist but are rejected with `block_not_allowlisted` — a different
error from `block_unknown` (block invented outright), so a bad tree tells you whether
to grow the allowlist or fix the prompt.

## Nesting

Two independent rules, both from the catalog, both enforced:

1. **Child-side** (`parents`) — a block declaring `parent:` in its `index.js` is legal
   *only* inside those parents. `styble/advanced-button` may only sit in
   `styble/advanced-buttons` or `styble/info-box`. Violation → `parent_not_allowed`;
   at the root → `root_requires_parent`.
2. **Parent-side** (`allowedChildren`) — a parent declaring `allowedBlocks` accepts
   *only* those children. `styble/container` accepts only `styble/column` and
   `styble/container`. Violation → `child_not_allowed`.

An **empty** `allowedChildren` on a block that accepts children means *no parent-side
restriction*, not "nothing allowed" — this is how `styble/column` holds arbitrary
content while still refusing a loose `advanced-button` (rule 1 catches that).

`acceptsChildren` is false for blocks that render no InnerBlocks; any children on them
→ `block_is_leaf`.

## Attribute values

Only attributes listed in the catalog's per-block `editable` map may be set
(`attr_unknown`). Values are checked against the recorded `type`, then against the
*shape of the recorded default*. Emitting a value identical to the default is always
legal, which covers `block.json` entries whose declared type contradicts their own
default.

| Shape | Used for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `single_responsive` | gaps, widths, font sizes, icon sizes | `{"device":{"Desktop":48,"Tablet":"","Mobile":""},"unit":{"Desktop":"px","Tablet":"px","Mobile":"px"}}` |
| `responsive_spacing` | padding, margin | `{"device":{"Desktop":{"top":0,"right":0,"bottom":0,"left":0},"Tablet":{},"Mobile":{}},"unit":{…},"allChange":false}` |
| `spacing` | border width/radius (non-responsive) | `{"value":{"top":0,"right":0,"bottom":0,"left":0},"unit":"px","allChange":false}` |
| `colors` | hover-capable colours | `{"normal":"","hover":"","active":""}` |
| icon | `featuredIcon`, `buttonIcon`, `listIcon`, `separatorIcon` | `{"source":"icon","iconName":"star","image":""}` |

Rules applied to responsive values: the only top-level keys are `device` and `unit`;
device keys come from `Desktop`, `Tablet`, `Mobile`; `Desktop` must be present (Tablet
and Mobile inherit from it); spacing buckets use only `top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left`.
Anything else → `attr_shape`.

## Containers and layouts

`layout` is a layout id from the catalog (`l-2-60-40`, `l-3-equal`, …). The catalog
records each layout's `columns` count and per-column `widths`, both derived from
`rows` in Styble Pro's `layouts.js`, so the contract can hold three facts together:

- `layout` must be a known id → else `layout_unknown`
- `columns`, when set, must equal the layout's column count → else `layout_columns_mismatch`
- the number of `styble/column` children, when there are any, must equal it too → else `layout_children_mismatch`
- `layoutSelected` must not be explicitly `false` while a layout is set → else `layout_selected_conflict`

`layout` itself is optional — a container without one is valid, and the applier
defaults it from the child count. Column widths are the applier's job, not the model's.

## Images

The model writes alt text; the user picks the media. `selectImage` must stay empty
(`{}`) and `selectImageId` must stay blank. An invented URL or attachment id →
`image_not_placeholder`.

## Placeholder copy

Several blocks ship real strings as `block.json` defaults — `separatorText` is
`"Separator"` (with `separatorLabelEnable` defaulting to **true**), and `listText` is
`"List Item Text"`. Sparse attributes mean an omitted key keeps that default, so these
attributes are on the v1 allowlist specifically to stop generated sections shipping
placeholder text. Set them, or set `separatorLabelEnable: false` for a plain rule.

## `uniqueId`

Never emitted by the model, never accepted from it. Styble blocks assign their own
`uniqueId` in a mount effect and scoped CSS keys off it, so a block that loses it
loses its styling. In the editor the effect runs by itself; headless PHP has no mount
effect and must mint the id, which is why the catalog records each block's
`uniqueIdPrefix` and the `uniqueIdRule` format. `styble/advanced-tab-pane` never calls
the hook and so must never be given one.

## Caps

| Cap | Value | Code |
|---|---|---|
| Containers (sections) per tree | 8 | `cap_containers` |
| Columns per container | 6 | `cap_columns` |
| Blocks per column | 8 | `cap_column_blocks` |
| Nesting depth | 8 | `cap_depth` |
| Nodes per tree | 200 | `cap_nodes` |

Validation also stops collecting after 50 errors and flags the result `truncated`.

## Error codes

Every error carries `code`, `path` (e.g. `root.children[0].attrs.layout`) and a
`message` written to be read by a developer *and* by the model during the corrective
retry. Errors accumulate — one pass reports everything wrong with the tree.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `envelope_not_object` | Tree is not a JSON object |
| `envelope_missing_key` | `version` or `root` absent |
| `envelope_unknown_key` | Extra top-level key |
| `version_mismatch` | `version` is not the catalog's contract version |
| `node_not_object` | Node is not a JSON object |
| `node_unknown_key` | Key other than `block`/`attrs`/`children` |
| `block_missing` | Node has no `block` |
| `block_not_string` | `block` is not a string |
| `block_unknown` | Not a Styble block |
| `block_not_allowlisted` | Real block, outside the v1 allowlist |
| `root_requires_parent` | Root block is only legal inside a parent |
| `parent_not_allowed` | Child-side `parent:` rule violated |
| `child_not_allowed` | Parent-side `allowedBlocks` rule violated |
| `block_is_leaf` | Children on a block with no InnerBlocks |
| `children_not_array` | `children` is not an array |
| `attrs_not_object` | `attrs` is not an object |
| `attr_unknown` | Attribute not AI-editable for this block |
| `attr_type` | Wrong scalar type |
| `attr_shape` | Object value does not match the default's shape |
| `image_not_placeholder` | Invented media URL or attachment id |
| `layout_unknown` | Not a Styble layout id |
| `layout_columns_mismatch` | `columns` disagrees with the layout |
| `layout_children_mismatch` | Column child count disagrees with the layout |
| `layout_selected_conflict` | `layoutSelected: false` with a layout set |
| `cap_*` | See Caps above |

## Why `strict: true` is off

A block tree is recursive, and provider-side structured output does not support
recursive schemas. `includes/class-prompt.php` expands the node schema to a bounded
depth (`SCHEMA_DEPTH`) instead, and leaves `attrs` free-form because the legal keys
differ per block. The schema therefore constrains *shape* only — the validator is the
enforcement layer, and the corrective retry is how a rejected tree gets a second
chance.

## Versioning

`contractVersion` lives in `scripts/generate-catalog.php` and is stamped into
`catalog/catalog.json`. Bump it when the envelope or node shape changes — not when the
allowlist or a block's editable attributes grow, since those are catalog data and old
trees stay valid.

## Inspecting what the model is told

```
php scripts/dump-prompt.php           # system prompt + tool schema
php scripts/dump-prompt.php --schema  # tool schema only
php scripts/dump-prompt.php --prompt  # system prompt only
```

Both are generated from `catalog/catalog.json`, so regenerating the catalog changes
what the model sees. Nothing is hand-maintained.
